changes.to: Checked 2026-11-28: Toyota Times (Toyota Motor Corporation) confirms CUE7 as the newest CUE model, debuted 2026-04-12 at TOYOTA ARENA TOKYO, a full model change with court movement and dribbling added. Toyota's own article publishes no spec table; the height and weight come from Toyota Alvark Tokyo's official signing release, which gives the roster profile 219 cm / 74 kg, and B.League coverage reports the mass dropping from CUE6's 120 kg to 74 kg. DoF, speed, battery and price are not published. Research/demonstration platform, not a product for sale.
Toyota's seventh-generation AI basketball humanoid: a 2.19 m biped that walks, dribbles and shoots, debuted at a Toyota Alvark Tokyo home game in April 2026.
